name: Dialog
description: Dialogs provide important prompts in a user flow. They can require an action, communicate information, or help users accomplish a task.

variants.name: Basic
variants.description: Standard dialog with headline, content, and actions

variants.name: Alert
variants.description: Alert dialog requiring user acknowledgment or decision

variants.name: Full-screen
variants.description: Dialog that covers the entire screen on mobile

props.name: type
props.description: The type of dialog for accessibility

props.name: noFocusTrap
props.description: Disables focus trapping within the dialog

props.name: returnValue
props.description: The value returned when the dialog closes

events.name: open
events.description: Fired when the dialog starts opening

events.name: opened
events.description: Fired when the dialog has finished opening

events.name: close
events.description: Fired when the dialog starts closing

events.name: closed
events.description: Fired when the dialog has finished closing

events.name: cancel
events.description: Fired when dialog is dismissed by scrim click or Escape

keyboardSupport.action: Move focus within dialog (trapped by default)

accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Dialog is labelled by headline slot. Use aria-label when no headline is present. Set type="alert" for important messages requiring action.
accessibility.focusManagement: Focus moves to first focusable element or element with autofocus. Focus is trapped within dialog. Returns to trigger element on close.

constraints.responsiveBehavior: Centered with margin. Full-screen variant on mobile breakpoints.

llm.intent: Display important information requiring user attention or action
llm.semanticMeaning: Modal container for focused user interaction
